title: Baa Juice Fresh Orange Fizz 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Baa Juice Nic Salt Fresh Orange Fizz delivers the zesty sweetness of fresh Orange, enhanced with a fizzy, sparkling finish. This bright and lively e-liquid offers a crisp and refreshing vape, perfect for fans of citrus blends with a twist. As part of the Baa Juice Bar Salts collection, this nicotine salt e-liquid features a double-concentrated flavour profile, designed to replicate the bold and intense taste of single-use disposable vape bars. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s perfect for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) pod kits and starter devices, providing smooth throat hits and fast nicotine satisfaction. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Fresh Orange Fizz offers a versatile and economical option for use with refillable vape devices.
